name: Raffles London at The OWO
insider_take: The world's most exclusive government building has been transformed into London's most prestigious address - where Churchill once walked the halls, you now walk into luxury.
whats_special: Housed in the historic Old War Office building, this hotel occupies the same corridors where Winston Churchill, James Bond creator Ian Fleming, and Lawrence of Arabia once worked. The Grade II listed Edwardian baroque building took over a decade to meticulously restore, featuring original marble columns, ornate ceilings, and period details alongside contemporary luxury. It's the first hotel to open within this iconic Whitehall landmark.
pro_tip: Book a suite facing Horse Guards Parade for front-row views of the Changing of the Guard ceremony - no crowds, just royal pageantry from your window.
dont_miss: The hotel's underground tunnels that once connected to Churchill's War Rooms, the original 1900s Otis elevator (still operational), and afternoon tea in the same room where wartime strategies were planned. The rooftop offers unparalleled 360-degree views of Westminster, Big Ben, and the London Eye.
pros: Historic Old War Office building with exceptional architectural heritage
Prime Whitehall location near Westminster and St. James's Park
Legendary Raffles service standards and butler service
Multiple dining venues including Michelin-starred options
cons: Limited availability due to exclusive boutique size
